acceptance_criteria.statement: Authorized GitHub/Jira and at least one real worker/provider route complete governed operations, while the Windows service and Command Center survive restart and expose truthful live state.

definition_of_done: A real worker/provider returns a governed result.
Windows install/start/restart/recovery and Command Center truth pass.
description: Qualify authorized external governance, real worker dispatch, native Windows supervision, and truthful Command Center interaction.
exclusions: Mocks do not satisfy live qualification.
Source assets do not satisfy Windows runtime qualification.
objective: Qualify live integrations, real workers, Command Center, and Windows service
observability_impact: Bind remote readbacks, worker receipts, service health, restart, and UI projections.
rationale: The existing offline preview and mocked remote behavior do not qualify the operational product.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Use sandbox targets, explicit approvals, reversible service procedures, and exact remote readback.
security_impact: Requires scoped credentials, independent approval, least privilege, and evidence redaction.
title: Live integrations, real workers, Command Center, and Windows qualification
